target_statement: Iterate consolidation, abstraction, reapplication, strengthening, and hostile audit over every indexed result artifact until the normalized theorem ledger reaches a verified fixed point.
normalization: Canonicalize each claim by architecture, source, mask, coefficient cone, sign, quantifier order, scale, resolution, conclusion, status, and trust before testing subsumption.
iteration_operator: extract exact schemas from the current ledger
deduplicate and compute strict hypothesis/conclusion subsumption
apply every surviving schema back to every compatible corpus cluster
seek nonlinear, multichannel, rate-free, and functorial strengthenings
run fiber, Fejer, prime-density pseudonode, finite-evidence, symmetry, and condition-number falsifiers
retain only exact proofs, imported theorems with a passport, or explicit countermodels
update the decision tree and repeat
convergence_rule: Converged only after two consecutive complete normalized passes add no theorem or lemma, weaken no hypothesis, strengthen no conclusion, merge no previously distinct schema, correct no status, and change no live decision-tree edge.
first_unproved_edge: Any proposed new abstraction must first prove that its quantifiers and topology are strong enough to subsume the source claims without importing their desired conclusions.
architectural_firewall: Weil, QP/Turan, R71-R89, and abstract operator results may share theorem schemas but no downstream implication crosses architectures without a separately proved adapter.
falsifiers: exact same-fiber or asymptotically indistinguishable pairs
decision_tree_change_if_successful: Replace repeated route-specific arguments by a minimal fixed-point basis of theorem schemas, strengthen the valid kill-switches and positive sockets, and remove every live target shown to be only a renamed or unstable adapter.
decision_tree_change_if_no_new_fixed_poi: Certify that the second-order basis is closed under the chosen abstraction and application operators, so further progress requires new zeta- or prime-specific input rather than another consolidation pass.
stop_rule: Do not stop for volume or fatigue; stop only at the two-pass zero-delta fixed point or at a rigorously documented contradiction in the normalization protocol.
